text:
elaine: FYI — FinReg asked if we can add automatic cache invalidation scoped to prompt-sets and rollouts. They want it early in Q3 for compliance workflows.
sam: Can we scope an MVP? Maybe advisory recommendations + eval webhooks first rather than full auto-invalid.
mohit: Technical quick take: cheapest MVP is TTL + manual tag invalidation + an opt-in webhook that triggers cache purge for a prompt-set. Rough effort: infra ~2w, runtime ~1w, QA/SDK ~1w.
nina: Regresion risk: if we invalidate too aggressively we'll blow perf. Need quality/regression gating tied to evals so we don't drop accuracy for cost gains.
anya: Draft launch criteria proposal:
- Documentation + migration guide
- Config UI (minimal) and API parity
- Perf impact <= 5% p50 latency on typical workloads
- Regression alerting enabled (eval set + threshold)
- Beta with 2 paying customers
opt-bot: Suggested cache policy prototype (for discussion):
```
cache_policy:
  mode: prompt-set
  ttl_seconds: 86400   # MVP default 24h
  invalidation_triggers:
    - manual_tag
    - webhook: /v1/cache/invalidate
  safety: enable_regression_check: true
```
sam: Acceptance testing we should require:
- Synthetic prompt set run (perf + cost)
- 3 customer prompt-sets (incl FinReg)
- Regression gating: quality drop <= 2% on core evals (or configurable per-customer)
mohit: Eval harness snippet (metrics + gate):
```
eval_config:
  metrics:
    - embedding_cosine
    - rouge_l
  gates:
    - metric: embedding_cosine
      threshold_drop: 0.02
      rollback: true
```
nina: Prioritization ask: where does this land vs batching/caching recs workstream? Both help cost but customer is revenue-impacting; I'd push cache-invalid as high priority, batching improvements next sprint.
elaine: Suggest we split scope into MVP and V1:
- MVP: TTL, manual invalidation, webhook trigger, basic eval hooks, docs
- V1: fingerprint-based auto-invalidation, UI controls, canary rollout + auto-rollback, per-customer configs
anya: Tie to OKRs: Q3 OKR → "Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by 10% via caching & batching". This maps directly. Proposed owners: Mohit (runtime) + Sam (product infra). Timeline: MVP 6 weeks, V1 + canary 12 weeks.
sam: Resource ask: 0.5 SWE, 0.5 infra, 1 SRE for rollout week, 0.2 docs/solutions. Budget impact: low infra, medium eng time.
nina: :thumbsup: add a compliance checklist item for Private deployments & KMS audit logs.
elaine: Good. I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize PRD bullets. @anya can you draft the PRD outline + acceptance criteria before sync?
anya: Yep will drop PRD draft in this thread by EOD. Also adding a quick ROI calc for FinReg.
opt-bot: Note: created a temporary card in #product-board: "cache-invalidation-prompt-set" with label: optimize-toolkit
mohit: One more: decide default gating metric for embeddings vs LM outputs. I'll propose embedding_cosine for retrieval-heavy flows, rouge/bleu for LM QA flows.
elaine: Great — keep discussion here. If we agree on MVP scope I'll flip to RFC/PRD next.
(reacted :eyes: by nina)
